column1: # retired-flat-migrations.tsv -- flat forward migrations RETIRED from the stream
# A flat migration in docker/migrations/forward/*.sql that was landed on dev but
# had NOT been applied by any managed lane, and whose precondition the lane
# cannot meet, is REMOVED from the corpus (file + rollback) and recorded here.
# This is the only retirement the k8s Job that applies the corpus
# (omninode_infra k8s/migrations/omnibase-infra-migrate.yaml) honours for a
# same-database file: the cross-database tombstone applies only to files whose
# \connect names a foreign database, docker/migrations/skip-manifest.yaml is
# read only by the compose-lane runner (scripts/run-forward-migrations.sh), and
# _ledger/migration-supersessions.tsv is node-only by scope. Never rewrite a
# retired migration to skip on insufficient_privilege instead: a fail-open
# migration is worse than a retired one.
# A retired ordinal is BURNED. The migration is re-issued as a NEW number once
# the condition in reissue_condition holds, starting from
# `git show <retired_from_commit>:docker/migrations/forward/<retired_forward>`.
# Gate: tests/unit/db/test_migration_104_retired_omn17923.py.
# Columns (tab-separated; `#` lines are comments):
#   retired_forward      file name under docker/migrations/forward/
#   retired_rollback     file name under docker/migrations/rollback/
#   retired_from_commit  full sha of the commit whose bytes were retired
#   forward_sha256       sha256 of the retired forward file's bytes
#   rollback_sha256      sha256 of the retired rollback file's bytes
#   tickets              comma-separated OMN references (retiring ticket first)
#   reissue_condition    what must be true before the migration comes back
#   reason               why it was retired, with the evidence
104_create_validator_ro_role.sql
column7: Re-issue as a NEW number (105 or higher, never 104) only after OMN-17923 lands: the omninode_infra projection of the topology (topology/kubernetes/projections/onex-dev.yaml, pinned at owner.commit 406d0d69 when this was retired) carries the validator_ro principal, so the 'Provision topology cluster roles (OMN-17347)' step of deploy-onex-staging.yml creates the role as the RDS master BEFORE the migrate Job runs -- the same seam that let 103 pass once omninode_infra#1106 landed. The re-issued file keeps 104's shape: guard-create, re-raise insufficient_privilege with the named remediation, GRANT CONNECT, aclexplode readback. The validator_ro principal declaration in src/omnibase_infra/topology/instances/{local,onex-dev,onex-prod}.yaml stays in place throughout; declaration is not provisioning and is harmless until the seam carries it.
column8: Retired before any managed lane applied it. 104 guard-creates validator_ro and, when the role is absent and the executing identity cannot create it, re-raises insufficient_privilege by design (there is no skip branch; 103's header rejects the masking skip). On the onex-dev serving RDS (omninode-dev-postgres, reached through the dev-system cluster node, database omnibase_infra) the flat loop of the migrate Job runs as role_omnibase_infra, read back live 2026-09-04T20:13:34Z (SSM 05265bc7-f5f7-460b-aae6-838aa30cdc50, read-only): rolcreaterole=f rolsuper=f rolbypassrls=f, member only of role_omninode_owner; validator_ro has no pg_roles row (positive control: 3 comparison roles returned); public.schema_migrations high-water is 103 (applied 2026-08-31T15:47:28Z), 104 absent. The OMN-17347 seam that would create the role first reads the omninode_infra projection, which does not carry validator_ro. So the next deploy-onex-staging run of any trigger -- ECR omnibase-infra-migrate bd280ca70 (2026-09-04T19:26:41Z) already carries 104 and the OMN-16493 resolve step selects the newest bundle -- would abort at 'Run database migrations' with SQLSTATE 42501, upstream of the overlay apply and the OMN-11969 boot gate, exactly as 103 did in run 33341217605 (2026-08-30T23:16:01Z, 'permission denied to create role'). A fail-open rewrite was rejected: retired instead. Byte-unchanged elsewhere: the retirement removes exactly these two files; schema_fingerprint.sha256 went from 9704108baac5ed8c212b64f64b7315bf4edc266dbb57ab61f87ec8b87bb5ae52 (89 files) to the restamped value (88 files).

column1: 107_create_action_authorization_nonce_claim.sql
column7: Re-issue under OMN-17486 as a NEW number (108 or higher, never 107) only after BOTH unmet preconditions are provisioned ahead of the migrate Job, and only when the OMN-17463 first-effect ledger family this migration belongs to is back in scope -- it is NOT beta scope by operator ruling of 2026-09-14 and is revisited after beta. (1) The rsd_action_authorization_claim restricted principal must be created by the privileged seam, which needs more than a topology entry: omninode_infra scripts/provision-cluster-roles.sh issues CREATE ROLE without NOINHERIT, and this migration's next branch rejects an inheriting role as 'must remain a non-owner restricted role', so the seam has to learn the attribute before a declaration would help. (2) The action_authorization_claim schema must exist: the migration asserts it and never creates it, and no seam on the managed lane provisions a schema at all -- provision-cluster-roles.sh says in its own header that schema and table privileges are out of its scope. Its owner (owner_omninode_internal) and domain (OMNINODE_INTERNAL) are already decided and declared. The re-issued file keeps 107's shape: guard-create the principal, assert the schema, re-raise with the named remediation, single-statement INSERT ... ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING ... RETURNING claim. Start from `git show 18b539f0f76fc4c5df1966d34ca4a2ebeba51f8f:docker/migrations/forward/107_create_action_authorization_nonce_claim.sql`. The action_authorization_claim schema declaration in src/omnibase_infra/topology/instances/{local,onex-dev,onex-prod}.yaml stays in place throughout; declaration is not provisioning and is harmless until a seam carries it.
column8: Retired before the serving managed lane applied it. Any ephemeral lane that recorded ordinal 107 remains distinguishable from a later re-issue because 107 is burned forever and the migration returns only as 108 or higher. 107 guard-creates rsd_action_authorization_claim and, when the role is absent and the executing identity cannot create it, re-raises insufficient_privilege by design; it then asserts the action_authorization_claim schema and raises invalid_schema_name if it is absent. Neither branch has a skip, deliberately. On the onex-dev serving RDS the flat loop of the migrate Job runs as role_omnibase_infra, which is NOCREATEROLE by contract. The cluster recorded the refusal itself in deploy-onex-staging run 34943161516 (2026-09-15T07:47:34Z, omninode_infra head 07293d45): 'psql:/work/107_create_action_authorization_nonce_claim.sql:54: ERROR: rsd_action_authorization_claim does not exist on this cluster and the executing role role_omnibase_infra cannot create it', after which the Job reached BackoffLimitExceeded. That is a live statement from the target cluster, not an inference. The migrate bundle is resolved as the NEWEST CI-built omnibase-infra-migrate image in ECR, not from the committed pin, so the image carrying 107 (tag 18b539f0f, pushed 2026-09-15T05:46:38Z) was selected automatically and every deploy-onex-staging run of any trigger has aborted at 'Run database migrations' since. That step is migration-order 1 of 6 and upstream of the overlay apply and the boot gate, so nothing reached onex-dev at all -- the same shape as 103 in run 33341217605 and 104 under OMN-17923. A fail-open rewrite was rejected: retired instead, per 103's header and the OMN-17923 precedent. Byte-unchanged elsewhere: the retirement removes exactly these two files and restores the stream to the fingerprint stamped at 18b539f0f's parent d10b5d712, sha256 3f8b15b6ace73ca12e6f862804effb61cb0df41aa98095eda8cf16ba5bb3c47e over 90 files; schema_fingerprint.sha256 goes from 1648196be84ca8dd784a4175085ae509b5a233d3c276af4b963093139c482460 (91 files) back to that value.
